title: BigP3BCI Study K — 9x8 adaptive/checkerboard, 2 sessions (5 healthy subjects)
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 5 healthy subjects performing a P300-based brain-computer interface (BCI) speller task using a 9x8 adaptive/checkerboard stimulus paradigm across 2 sessions. The data were acquired at 256 Hz using 16 channels with a g.USBamp amplifier and represent a derivative subset of the BigP3BCI study, the largest public P300 BCI dataset containing recordings from approximately 267 subjects across 20 studies. This subset is optimized for benchmarking and developing BCI algorithms for visual perception and character selection tasks.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired at a sampling rate of 256 Hz using 16 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage with a g.USBamp (g.tec) amplifier. The experimental paradigm employed a P300-based speller task with a 9x8 adaptive/checkerboard stimulus presentation. Subjects completed 2 sessions, with each trial spanning 1.0 second. Target and non-target visual stimuli were presented, and online feedback was provided during the BCI application in a laboratory environment.
